_Info: Checkup Add-In 2026 — Checkup_Settings.json. Factory default presets: 1 to 12 entries (Id optional — generated when missing; Name = button label). Reset restores this list. User-saved presets are stored in the Windows Registry (HKCU\Software\Checkup 2026\Presets). The former StylePurge section is gone: style cleanup is now an iLogic rule in the Rules folder next to the add-in DLL.
